_comment: Festival bosses (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md item 437, scripts/core/FestivalBoss.gd). While a festival runs, the crier offers a fight against a grown echo of a Rift heart the player has already beaten. It fights with that heart's boss rules (BattleRules.BOSSES[boss]); ring = the party's best ring + ring_over, between ring_min and the story ring. The first win per festival and year pays 'ribbons' festival ribbons.
offer: Crier: An echo of the %s has crashed the festival in the shape of a %s. Nobody invited it. Will you see it out?
locked: Crier: Something from the Rifts keeps trying to get in. Seal a Rift heart first, then we'll talk.
done: Crier: You saw the echo out already. It sulks somewhere behind the stands until next year.
win: The echo comes apart like old bunting. The crowd claps as if it had helped.
loss: The echo keeps dancing. The crowd decides it is part of the show.
